lines.en: When she opens the door, she falls into a pit. And after a lengthy battle with quicksand, she emerges in the halls of a familiar place.
Never at night, though. There was no reason to come here once the sun settled into its resting place — signaling to its brother “Moon” that it was time for a shift change.
A bell goes off, but there is no imposing disclosing of an encroaching symposium — just radio silence and white noise so quiet it still meets the criteria of “nothingness.”

Cold air blows in through the windows, each one with invisible cracks left by malicious glassmakers tired of teenage girls walking all over their hard work in exchange for temporary poignancy and pleasure.
She can hear cracking noises slipping out from where her loafers meet the linoleum, but she’s too busy wondering how she got here to waste her worries on suspicious, misplaced foley.
It’s because of this that she doesn’t hear the footsteps behind her, keeping in time with hers as she leads someone somewhere.
They stop soon-after, waiting for the girl to progress. But how can such a thing even happen when each blink takes her backwards? When each step shakes more quicksand out of her shoes.

It’s okay, though! You can make glass out of that too! You can make glass out of anything these days! Which might explain why we all feel so fragile — how we can crack if someone looks at us the wrong way.
We can crack when no one looks at us too, though.

Every step is a risk. Every thought is a risk. But just waiting is a risk! So all you can really do is sprint as fast as you can so no one tries to steal your pieces to make up for the gaps they’ve put in themselves.
: Um...Maya?
: Huh?!
It’s then that she finally notices the creature trailing her — more dangerous, yet somehow more fuckable than an adult black bear. But would he be willing to stay awake through the winter for her?
: You just...stopped. I don’t know what you want me to do with these.
: Sensei?...
: Uh...yes?
: I don’t...really...uhh...
: Where...
: Did you see...Ami walk by?...I think I’m...supposed to be looking for her...
: Uhh...no?
: I kind of just assumed she was in your room, but I never got a chance to check since you shoved these boxes into my arms the second I showed up there.
: R-Right! Yeah!

: Listen, I’m...I’m sorry for freaking out earlier. It’s just...you know, you’ve been so distant lately and...ugh...it’s going to sound annoyingly sappy but, like...I can feel you sort of...slipping away.
: Y-You don’t have to say anything back! I just...figured I should maybe explain myself since I stormed out on a bad note and...
: If there’s anything I can do to keep you with me, just tell me. I really am ready to talk about this...alternate Maya or whatever it is you guys all seem to be hung up on.
: Maya, what the fuck are you talking about?
: The...you know! The thing! The one you keep being all sad and fucking depressing about?! Where I’m “not actually me” or whatever it is?!
: The reason you’re dumping me for Niki! Or at least the...thing I think you’re dumping me over? God, I really hope that’s it. Because if it’s anything else-
: Maya, chill. I’m not “dumping you” for anyone.
: You’re...you’re not?
: Of course not. And especially not Niki. I can’t even remember the last time I talked to her. I know how that makes you feel, so I try to stay away.
: But...But you said earlier, that...
: A-Actually...nevermind! Just forget I even said anything. Hahahah...I think I’m, uhh...going a little crazy or...something like that.
: I’ll say. I still have no idea what you even want me to do with these things. But my arms are starting to get tired, so-
: Just drop them then. I can’t even remember what’s...in those anyway.
: Say no more.
: I hope it was...nothing fragile, though.
: What do you want to do now, then?
: Wh...What do you mean?
: I mean now that we’re done with your weird chore. Do you want to go out to eat or something? That takoyaki stand is probably still open, right?
: T...Takoyaki?
: The one with the old guy who always looks at me like I’m a serial killer and communicates solely through grunting.
: Oh! R...Right. That takoyaki stand. How could I forget?
: Beats me. That seems like the only place you ever want to eat nowadays. But if you’d rather just walk around town or head back to my place instead, that’s fine by me.
: Yeah, I’m...not that hungry right now anyway...
: Okay. I was curious before, but now I know something is wrong.
: Nothing’s wrong at all! I just-
: Oh god. We are...suddenly very close.
: You’re hiding something from me. Why?
: Why? Because it’ll make me sound fucking insane! That’s why. I have no idea what’s happening to me right now.
: Well, why not try explaining it then? Tons of crazy stuff has happened to us. It’ll take a lot more than being unaware of your surroundings to make me think you’re insane, Maya.
: Okay, sure. But how about being in like three different timelines at once? How does that make me sound?
: Kind of insane, yeah.
: See?! I told you!
: It’s fine, though. That’s nothing compared to what I’ve put you through, I’m sure. The least I can do is try and keep you grounded for a minute, right?
: Maybe more than a minute if that’s okay. Because you do put me through a lot. And being with you like this again is probably all I need to start feeling, like...okay.
: You sure this is all you want?
: Why? Is there something else you had in mind?
: I could fuck you. That normally fixes everything, doesn’t it?
: Like...like right here?
: Yeah. We’ve never done it in school before. Now’s the perfect time to try it out, isn’t it?
: So you’re actually, like...the one initiating it this time?
: Why are you saying that like it’s a weird thing for me to do?
: Because it has been lately! I keep having to come to you! And it’s been super exhausting and upsetting because it makes me feel like you’re getting bored of me!
: Probably just your “insanity” talking again. If I was ever going to get bored of you, it would have happened years ago.
: Yeah, well maybe I’ve just outgrown your tastes now. Creep.
: Oh, shut up. You’ve barely grown at all since we met. But I doubt my feelings will change even when we’re old. That’s why I promised to be with you forever.
: You don’t mean that.
: Which part?
: The one where you’ll still go to town on me when I’ve outgrown my uniform. The “forever” part is believable because I’m going to force it on you even if you do get tired of me.
: Controlling as always.
: I’m only like this because you’re a fucking pushover. One of us has to wear the pants, you know.
: And the other one has to take them off.
: I’m wearing a skirt, idiot.
: Not for long...
: A...Akira?...
: Ah...You’re supposed to call me “Sensei” while we’re in school, remember?
: Yes...S...Sensei...
: Good girl...Now, tell Sensei how he can cheer you up...
: Promise me again that you’re not leaving me for your stupid childhood friend.
: I promise.
: Or anyone else.
: Or anyone else.
: And that you won’t listen to Ami if she tries to force you to have a threesome with us. Unless you actually want to. I’d be open to it if that’s the case. But I get to go first.
: ...What?
: Long story. Doesn’t matter. Kiss me now, please.
: Can’t I tease you a little first? I like how feisty you get when I don’t give you what you want right away.
: Suck.
: Mm...mlm...Sensei...
: There’s my good girl...
: See? I can wear the pants when I have to...
: Now, look at me.
: Mm...mlm...
: You like that?
: Mhm...
: You want me to fuck all your worries away again?...
: Mh-
: I told you to fucking look at me.
: Mm! Mhmm.....mlm....mmmm!
: You like it when I talk to you like that, huh?
: Mm! Mmhmm...mmmm!
: Still want me to kiss you?
: No...just fuck me...we can skip the kissing part...I want you inside me...
: Well, now I have to kiss you.
: You fucking-
: Mmmmmffff!
: Mn...mnch...Maya...
: Sensei...Sensei!
Reunited at last! But were they really?
With how frequent and drastic Maya’s leaps through time had become, there was no way of discerning whether or not this was a memory, the future, or even a dream!

That didn’t matter to her right now, though. All that mattered were indulging in these feelings as she had no way of knowing if she’d ever feel them again if she did return to where she was meant to be.
She reaches down and grabs his wrist in an attempt to bring him even closer.
He resists at first, only to frustrate her more. But she wins in the end. She always does. She always did.
And within a matter of seconds, her fingers are curled around his hand as he uses his fingers to slide her panties to the side.
He slips inside of her desperately eager crevice with ease, skipping the teasing portion entirely at this point as his resolve has already dissolved.

Their tongues and teeth and mouths go to war with one another as his fingers move faster. Her legs begin to shake. And she wants to cum right now, but she’d rather hold it in and make him work harder.
She was trembling. He was trembling. They both were trembling. And they wanted nothing more than to collapse to the floor and combine their love until it created something new.
But that never happened because the memory or future or dream came to an end and was replaced with a better one!
: Mmmffff! Mmm!
: Oh. My. God.
: Maya, what the heck was that?! There’s not supposed to be any tongue involved in spin the bottle! It was supposed to just be a little kiss! Now I’m probably pregnant!
: I-I-I-I-I don’t...I didn’t mean to...I thought you were Sensei!
: That somehow makes it even worse! Also, how?! Look at me!
: Well, I guess this is a thing that’s happened now.
: I’m sorry! I didn’t...I had no idea she wasn’t you! Just a second ago, I-
: Hey, you don’t have to apologize to me. That was awesome. I say you do it again.
: Seconded from the back! Rin is mere moments away from forgetting I stole her first kiss a moment ago! One more kiss should serve as the killing blow!
: Oh. My. God.
: You know, I always had a feeling Maya was secretly into girls. I guess that kind of seals the deal, huh?
: I don’t...I didn’t...uhh!
: Bye!
And so Halloween becomes not-Halloween becomes Christmas! And Maya becomes a lesbian! What’s next — Sensei kissing Taco Man during Dorm Wars on the beach?!
or perhaps there lies another place for gods to go to sleep
perhaps they’ll all make fun of us. perhaps they’ll call us sheep.
for being what we want to be in worlds that don’t deserve
girls and boys that look like us, with bells to match our curves.
What would you say if I told you there was nothing?
- the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  the girl  it’s me
